svg.title: Ἡ ὁδός· ἐκ Σάρδεων εἰς Ταρσούς
svg.desc: Map of Asia Minor drawn from Natural Earth coastline data (public domain): the route of Cyrus’s march as a dashed line with a dot at each stopping place, from Sardis inland east to Celaenae, on to Tyriaeum, then south-east through the mountains into Cilicia and down to Tarsus; the Pisidians in the mountains south of the route, the sea to the west.
